module: The "shelves" (on-disk library) that placed sites come from: buildings, open spaces, parking lots. Three editors bake their sites there and one placer reads them all; this module fixes once where they live and how their files are named. A site is a folder named after its slug, containing the manifest (<kind>.json: bounds, kit transforms, ground plan, lamps, plants), model.json (the editable document, to reopen the site in the editor that created it) and shell.dae (unique geometry, LODs and collision).
notes: Shelves (kinds): building -> /assets/massingBuildings/ (manifest building.json, editor editor_massingEditor); openSpace -> /assets/openSpaces/ (openSpace.json, editor_openSpaceEditor); carPark -> /assets/carParks/ (carPark.json, editor_parkingLotEditor). Each entry also has id, noun, label, icon.
kindOf returns the "building" shelf for an unknown or nil kind.
The manifest is written compact (it contains thousands of transforms); model.json is written indented.
wipe also deletes the .cdae cache next to a .dae, without which the engine loads it instead of the new file.
The disk functions use FS (directoryExists, directoryCreate, directoryList, directoryRemove, findFiles, removeFile): without FS they do nothing and list returns an empty list.
The auto page flags a global "i": these are loop variables.

kinds.desc: List of shelves: { id, noun, label, icon, root, manifest, editor }.

modelFile.desc: File name of the editable document: 'model.json'.

shellFile.desc: File name of the unique geometry: 'shell.dae'.

kindOf.desc: Returns the shelf definition for an identifier (building by default).

slugify.desc: Folder name derived from the object's name: lowercase, everything that is not alphanumeric becomes an underscore, edge underscores removed. A new bake of a renamed but identical site therefore overwrites its own folder. An empty name gives the kind's common name.

rootOf.desc: Root folder of a shelf (for example /assets/openSpaces/).

folderFor.desc: Folder of a site: root + slug + '/'.

manifestPath.desc: Path of a site's manifest in its folder dir.

ensureRoot.desc: Ensures the shelf folder exists. The file dialog only LISTS the given path without creating it: without this call, the first bake on a fresh install would open the dialog on a nonexistent folder.

wipe.desc: Empties a folder before rewriting, so that a smaller bake leaves nothing stale; also deletes the .cdae caches.

prepare.desc: Creates the site folder if needed, empties it and returns it ready to write. Every bake starts here.

writeModel.desc: Writes the editable document next to its meshes: { version = 1, tool, state }. tool is the editor that wrote it, so that a folder opened by the wrong one reports it.

writeManifest.desc: Writes the manifest (compact), then notifies the observers registered by onWritten with (kind, manifest.slug).

manifest.desc: Manifest with at least the slug field.

returns.desc: false if the write failed, true otherwise.

onWritten.desc: Registers an observer called each time a site is written to a shelf. Observers are never removed.

exists.desc: Is the name already taken? This is what Save As asks before overwriting someone's work.

remove.desc: Removes a site from the shelf, folder included. A rename is a save under the new name followed by this call on the old one, which keeps the name stored in the manifest honest.

returns.desc: true if deleted, false if absent.
Deleted folder, or 'not in the library'.

list.desc: Everything already on a shelf, sorted by name. Reads only the manifests (one small json read per site, no mesh). Each entry is the manifest augmented with dir (its folder) and kind (its shelf), which is enough for the placer to stand it up.

returns.desc: Manifests (with slug), augmented with dir and kind.
